rationale:
Idea:
The evolution from Version 1 to Version 2 replaced the complex Gated Delta Product and standard MLP with a Spiking State Space Model (SS4D) layer. This shift fundamentally improves long-range dependency modeling with sub-quadratic complexity, aligning with the

callouts.1: Input-spike mask: the normalised input is spiked by a LIF neuron and those binary spikes zero out SSM channels, ỹ = y ⊙ LIF(u), making the readout input sparse.
callouts.2: Spiking MLP readout: the standalone LIF and non-spiking Conv1×1·GLU are replaced by two SpikingLinears (d → 2d → d) that both see binary spikes.
callouts.3: Spiking residual gate: short convs + SpikingLinears + σ turn the residual into x⊙(1−f) + y⊙i, so spikes decide how much of the old stream is forgotten and how much new output is written.
